body:
CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: Guest-mode messaging now gives the real SSH connect command instead of stale 'coming soon' wording: new sshUpgradeHint constant ('ssh -p 2222 okemily.com...') used consistently in the connect banner, economy/chat block messages, and requireSSHIdentity's own key-management refusal. New regression test guards against 'coming soon' ever creeping back in. Live-verified. Commits cb63dc4 (source) + b732089 (binary redeploy). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
